import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyberpunk'
response = requests.get(url)
soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
# Find the section about visual style
# The section id is 'Visual_style' or 'Aesthetics'
import re
for header in soup.find_all(['h2', 'h3']):
    if 'visual' in header.get_text().lower() or 'aesthetics' in header.get_text().lower():
        print(header.get_text())
        # Print all following p tags until next header
        for sibling in header.find_next_siblings():
            if sibling.name in ['h2', 'h3']:
                break
            if sibling.name == 'p' or sibling.name == 'ul':
                print(sibling.get_text())
